mode_selection_rule.rule: First message determines session mode permanently (SESSION_STICKY)
mode_selection_rule.condition: if len(first_msg) >= 24 and first_msg[0:4] == 0x4e584e43 ('CNXN') then ADB_PACKET_MODE else BARE_RAW_PTY_MODE

CNXN.behavior: Logs '[ADB] Received CNXN, replying CNXN', responds with CNXN packet

OPEN.behavior: Logs '[ADB] Received OPEN', allocates PTY/pipe, starts shell (/system/bin/sh or /bin/sh), responds with OKAY (0x59414b4f)

WRTE.behavior: Writes payload bytes to shell stdin via (*os.File).Write, responds with OKAY (0x59414b4f)

CLSE.behavior: Logs '[ADB] Received CLSE, closing session', tears down session, responds with CLSE (0x45534c43)

OKAY.behavior: Sent by Agent to acknowledge OPEN and WRTE commands

mode_2_bare_raw_pty_framing.stream_demultiplexing: NONE (direct stream pipe between WebRTC and PTY)
